## Behavioral tradeoffs

- **flight_fuel_handoff / accounting_integrity_fix**: At planned-to-manual handoff advance the native manual progress watermark without charging travel already paid by NavData; persist an optional handoff marker through native command payloads. Removes: Duplicate debit for intervening planned travel when the same trip resumes manual accounting.. Preserves: Native path and collision choices.; Native planned fuel spending and subsequent manual spending/exhaustion.; Docked Hold's existing help/fuel policy; no rescue is invented..
- **scav_emergency_recovery / native_control_flow_repair**: Finish ordinary empty visits, reject genuinely unaffordable homeward legs and retain the scav controller across SOS sends; native asset eligibility and dispatch remain authoritative. Removes: Empty ordinary visit deadlock and premature retirement after SOS.. Preserves: Help-in-progress and unrelated Holds.; Feasible manual/rotor/interregional fusion navigation.; Native player-first routing and conditional ATC dispatch..
- **scav_selection_wait / native_control_flow_repair**: Keep failed retained selection at Main[1], respect the absolute retry deadline and authored assistance flag instead of advancing into targetless visit Hold. Removes: False successful selection and targetless visit continuation.. Preserves: Native messages, failed assistance and independent controller..
- **scav_return_fallback / simulation_policy**: After native random selection fails, accept a native station return only when the registered destination and one-way plan pass. Removes: Immediate distress when sampled jobs failed but a return plan exists.. Preserves: Native successful job selection, unaffordable return failure, travel and docking..
- **orbital_waiting / simulation_policy**: Free unpowered vacuum waits retain normal gravity; atmospheric, combat, powered, docked and locked modes keep native behavior. Removes: Gravity exemption for eligible orbital waits.. Preserves: Position, velocity, fuel and specialized wait exclusions..

## Dependencies not transition-expanded

- **shallow_flight_control_handoff**: Native-tested autonomous FlyTo RCS/pause, explicit TorchOff and direct RCS commands release unowned shallow AI torch input. Active NavData excludes direct-actuator cleanup. Changed escape/retreat destinations stop obsolete controls. Momentum, fuel, new RCS input, active courses and physical/player control paths are preserved. No affordability gate or new rescue policy. Numerical flight remains external; see Navigation/FLIGHT-CONTROL-HANDOFF.md.
- **shared_navigation**: General target/prediction integrity remains unexpanded. Failed-selection caller, retry and targetless Hold continuation are now expanded; numeric clock, condition expiry and physical wait exclusions are verified in native offline tests.
- **rcs_replenishment**: Shared actual-refill route translation is natively tested and expanded in the deployer slice. Numeric loaded-tank debt and refill coincidence are outside this slice.
- **escape_handoff**: Production escape setter uses coherent native assignment and invalidates obsolete routes for semantic goal changes. Native caller evidence: Notes/AI-RETARGET-CALLER-AUDIT.md. Complete combat/retreat is outside this slice; generic ApplyToShip route invalidation has not been generalized. Navy/Blockade already clear routes through TargetNearestStation.
- **planet_safe_avoidance**: Shared native evasion rejects past-only warnings and vets opposite dodges against bodies and moving obstacles. No target/retirement policy changes. Full flight geometry remains outside this slice; see Navigation/PLANETARY-AVOIDANCE-AUDIT.md and Tests/PlanetaryNavigationCheck.
- **station_docked_traffic**: Saved PDA policy, default on: nonstation hulls connected to stations/apartments are nonhazards while enabled; disabling immediately restores native hull treatment. Enabled hulls are nonhazards for ship contact, AI evasion and proximity scans. Free-space tows, actual stations, weapon/planet hits remain native. Shared-command fixture evidence; no geometric transition model or forced arrival.
- **local_navigation_frames**: Native-tested local patrol/ambush/guard/encounter coordinate binding and police SFF placement preserve actual planetary gravity wells/parent references; otherwise use the regional station frame. Departure validation shared. No global gravity/nearest query, free-target prediction, combat or interplanetary course changes. Full military behavior and flight geometry remain unexpanded; see Navigation/LOCAL-NAVIGATION-FRAMES.md.

These unresolved boundaries prevent calling this an all-patches effective simulation. Native inner/outer Harmony phases and side effects must be expanded before drawing conclusions across them.
